painpoints.text: The loop's stale-evidence rule (ADR-0015) currently blocks its own freshest terminal evidence: run 01M5JE7BE3GESN601QX66XWVB6 completed 2026-10-22 18:50 but the currently-running loop run 01M5JGKB8Z6T63N3YS5QY444QT bumped the loop workflow_version_id to 81e060e628fa5a1f01ae93243062bb6e715eee4eff6cb277d877b78748a82136, so no terminal loop run can ever match the baseline while any loop run is active mid-tree-change. Consider deriving the baseline from the newest TERMINAL run per workflow, or an explicit 'baseline promoted on completion' rule, so fresh terminal evidence is not perpetually unrevisable.
